text: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend three candidates to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Investment Board.

City Council on December 15, 16 and 17, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Toronto Investment Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending December 16, 2025, and until successors are appointed: John Crocker, as Chair Kevin Adolphe Sue Lemon 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 5 to the report (November 24, 2021) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Investment Board.
